prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. G07-A, realistic material rendering of an explicitly didactic underground foundation cutaway, NOT a real construction photograph. One 3:2 landscape image, no text.
Input image 1 is a meter-scaled 3D geometric reference: preserve its slender vertical proportions. Input image 2 is the EXACT pile layout viewed from above: eight circles mean EIGHT piles in TWO parallel rows of FOUR; the centre rectangle is the pier, not an extra pile. Use image2 to prevent occlusion in image1 from being mistaken for fewer piles. Do not include a separate plan diagram in final artwork.
Render one complete pile-group foundation as a sophisticated architectural cutaway with realistic concrete and three restrained natural soil strata. Front soil is selectively cut away to see pile shafts; retain a rear soil wall, a little side contact and continuous soil at pile tips, so no pile appears suspended in space. All eight pile tops must physically join the underside of the cap. Use an oblique viewpoint where both rows can be followed, partial occlusion is allowed without deleting piles. Entire pier, cap and pile tips inside frame. The foundation is tall and slim; do not shorten piles to make a compact object.
Meter geometry contract, NEVER print dimensions: cap8 along x by6 along y by2 thick; top z=-1, bottom=-3, groundz0. Exactly8 cylindrical piles diameter1, length20, x centres -2.7,-0.9,+0.9,+2.7 in EACH of two rows y=-1.8,+1.8; pile topz-3, bottomz-23. Centre pier2 by2.5 rectangular, extends from cap topz-1 to ground-abovez8. Piles are TEN times cap thickness and TWENTY diameters long. Pier is9 high above cap, not a giant bridge tower. Soil contacts pile sides and pile tips; layer geology is only invented teaching context, not survey data.
Style: convincingly textured concrete and soil in soft daylight, clean neutral off-white background, precise restrained educational cutaway, no vegetation hiding the structure. Do not simulate a real excavated pit; this is a removed-soil viewing convention.
No people, no hands, no vehicles, no reinforcement cages, no machinery, no detached cap, no floating pile heads or tips, no additional piles, no squashed proportions. No arrows, lettering, numbers, dimensions, labels, equations, stress colors, clouds, load-sharing percentages, logos or watermark.

dimensions_contract.model_status: teaching pile-group cutaway, not a named real foundation
dimensions_contract.soil_note: schematic layers for contact context only, no measured geology, strength, side/end load share or stresses

checks.item: 画面无文字、数值、箭头和云图
所见桩头与承台相接、桩端与保留土体相接
八根桩、两排四根可核验

observations: 可清楚追踪约六条桩身轮廓，八桩两排布置不能从成图独立确认。
承台、墩身、长桩和剖切土层关系存在，但并不构成尺寸合格。
limitations: 本图不得代替F32参数图或用作八桩数量/尺寸教学证据。
土层是教学剖切假设，不能解释为真实勘察或已经计算的桩侧、桩端分担。
像素审查没有证明实际尺寸；合同是生成约束而非成图实测结果。

file_checks.note: File integrity and format checks only; geometric/visual review is recorded separately.
